hero.headline: Every pixel, on purpose.
hero.body: I'm Sam Stringer-Hye, a Philadelphia-based Associate Design Director at Razorfish with 13+ years in UX, UI, and motion. I lead design system and product teams for Samsung, Amica, Frontier, and CVS.

items.title: Teams
items.body: I led six designers through the Amica.com design system rebuild, and teams of three to five on Samsung, CVS, and Frontier.

items.title: Mentorship
items.body: I mentor designers at Razorfish and through the Publicis mentorship program, on systems thinking, UX craft, and career growth.

items.title: AI adoption
items.body: As an AI advocate for Razorfish's creative team, I built our AI roadmap, surveyed designers on their tools, and brought AI into client work, from a component audit to first-draft pages built with Claude.

items.title: Scope calls
items.body: When scope grew after kickoff with no notice to design, I escalated it into a named decision with an owner instead of letting the team absorb it.

jobs.title: Associate Design Director
highlights: Leads UX and design systems for Samsung, Frontier, and CVS product redesigns.

jobs.title: Senior Designer
highlights: Designed flows, prototypes, and motion systems for Samsung and Barclays. Built the interaction patterns, delivered the specs.

jobs.title: Product Designer
highlights: Built interactive prototypes and motion systems for early-stage products and client pitches. The kind of work that turns a deck into something you can actually click through.

jobs.title: Art Director
highlights: Led design and motion direction for Mashable's Snapchat Discover launch and ran daily creative production.

jobs.title: Motion Designer
highlights: Built the motion templates behind NowThis's daily social videos and redesigned the brand identity at an early stage.
